stem:
A random variable $X$ has probability density function defined by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} k\left(\frac{1}{x^2} + \frac{1}{x^3}\right) & 1 \leqslant x \leqslant 2, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $k$ is a constant.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text: Three values of $X$ are chosen at random. Find the probability that one of these values is less than 1.5 and the other two are greater than 1.5.
